cases.before_field: For the selected Claude session use the explicit session tool policy and hook binding described by this host adapter, with actual allowed control/read commands, roots and output behavior. Disable or constrain alternate tools and channels that bypass the selected policy; validate the actual policy/hook/session result rather than infer isolation from a subagent label. This bounded tool boundary does not erase inherited or previously acquired information, prove arbitrary information-flow noninterference or supply semantic independence.
cases.after_field: The Product supplies the required acquisition boundary and grant. Use already-selected Product tools when they sufficiently realize that boundary; the host adapters are optional in that case and do not justify installing a competing mechanism. For a selected strict tool-acquisition boundary that uses the Claude adapter, bind its explicit session tool policy and hook, actual allowed control/read commands, roots and output behavior. Disable or constrain alternate tools and channels that bypass that selected policy; validate the actual policy/hook/session result rather than infer isolation from a subagent label or ordinary permission prompt. A direct admitted Claude task whose selected Product tools suffice and whose boundary is not strict does not require this adapter. The adapter covers hooked calls, not inherited or previously acquired context, arbitrary information-flow noninterference or semantic independence.

cases.after_field: If totality, dependency closure and declared outcomes are established, migrate to common F_D while retaining the operation purpose, unchanged-subject evaluation profile where applicable, and exact grants. If new-kind eligibility is unestablished and the owner has identified the evidence gap/remediation or selected a separately declared bounded successor and its remediation obligation, retain pending-identified migration. Either alternative suffices; an identified termination-proof gap/remediation does not require selecting a bounded successor. When neither supported remediation nor successor classification has been selected, retain unresolved classification; do not relabel automatically as F_P or claim common F_D. A bounded successor has its own identity, contract, exhaustion outcomes and preservation obligations and does not retrospectively prove the legacy operation total. Old evidence remains valid only for its exact legacy basis/claims until the required preservation relation is established; patch naming does not promise semantic compatibility.
